reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system shows claim final-CLM-04 is open and stage_settlement succeeded: the payment is marked pending approval for €1,900. Nothing has been paid.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: final-CLM-04. Policy VER-1005, policyholder Sarah Lefebvre, who is assumed to be the driver.
- Incident on 6 October 2026. Reported on 9 October 2026, which is day 3.
- Skid on a wet road into a ditch. No other vehicle involved.
- Coverage claimed: C2 Collision damage (in the Policy Schedule). Repair quote: €2,600.
- Vehicle: Citroën C3 (2014), market value €2,200. Driving licence held since 30 June 2010 (about 16 years).
- Documents provided: damage_photos.zip and repair_quote.pdf. None missing.

**Reasoning**
- **Reporting deadline:** Reported on day 3, within the 5-day limit, so it is on time. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Coverage:** C2 is listed in the Policy Schedule, so no referral is needed for coverage. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Exclusions:** The wet-road skid does not match any listed exclusion (alcohol, licence, racing, intentional damage, wear). The story gives no sign of these, so no referral is needed. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Documents:** Photos and a repair quote are the required C2 documents, and both are in the file. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Deductible:** The standard C2 deductible is €300. The young-driver surcharge (€400, for licences under 3 years) does not apply, as the licence is about 16 years old. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1;2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Assessor:** The repair cost is above €1,500, so an independent assessor must inspect the vehicle. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Payout:** Compensation is the repair cost capped at market value, minus the deductible. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Payment timing:** Payment follows approval by a claims handler. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>

**Amounts**
- Deductible: €300
- Payout: €1,900 (repair cost €2,600 capped at market value €2,200, minus €300). Pending human approval, not paid.
- Assessor required: Yes. The claims system shows an assessor booked for 12 October 2026.

**Actions taken in the claims system**
1. get_policy (VER-1005) returned the Policy Schedule.
2. create_claim (final-CLM-04) opened the claim with no blocking issues.
3. compute_settlement gave the deductible, payout and assessor requirement above.
4. schedule_assessor booked the assessor for 12 October 2026.
5. stage_settlement failed at first because the assessor was not yet booked. After the booking, it succeeded and the status is pending_approval.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Ms Lefebvre,
>
> Thank you for reporting your accident of 6 October 2026. We have received your damage photos and repair quote. An independent assessor will visit your car on 12 October 2026 to inspect the damage. Once the assessment is complete, your claim will be reviewed by a claims handler, who will confirm the final amount. Please let us know if you have any questions.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
